visual.name: chartFusionGlow
visual.description: A certified-ready compact Power BI trend chart and aligned matrix visual.

dataRoles.name: xAxis
dataRoles.description: Creates chart x-axis points and matrix columns.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Creates chart series and matrix rows.

dataRoles.name: filterOne
dataRoles.description: Optional top filter shown above the visual.

dataRoles.name: filterTwo
dataRoles.description: Optional second top filter shown above the visual.

dataRoles.name: values
dataRoles.description: One numeric measure used by both the chart and table.

dataRoles.name: yAxisMinimum
dataRoles.description: Optional DAX measure that dynamically sets the chart Y-axis minimum.

dataRoles.name: yAxisMaximum
dataRoles.description: Optional DAX measure that dynamically sets the chart Y-axis maximum.

dataRoles.name: additionalRowValues
dataRoles.description: Optional numeric measures shown as table-only rows. They do not affect chart values.

dataRoles.name: referenceLine
dataRoles.description: Optional numeric measure rendered as a target, average, or median line on the chart.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Optional fields shown only in tooltips.

useDynamicYAxisBounds.description: Use the optional Y-axis minimum and Y-axis maximum measure wells from Build visual. Assigned measures override automatic or manual bounds.
